description: Defines the net::IPEndPoint class representing an IP address and port, with methods for serialization, deserialization, and socket address conversions.

classes.name: net::IPEndPoint
classes.description: Represents an IP endpoint with address and port, providing serialization, deserialization, and socket address conversion methods.

methods.name: GetFamily()
methods.description: Returns the address family (IPv4, IPv6, or unspecified).

methods.name: GetForAllInterfaces(int port)
methods.description: Returns an endpoint for all interfaces on the given port (STARBOARD only).

methods.name: ToSbSocketAddress(SbSocketAddress* out_address) const
methods.description: Converts to a Starboard socket address (STARBOARD only).

methods.name: FromSbSocketAddress(const SbSocketAddress* address)
methods.description: Initializes from a Starboard socket address (STARBOARD only).

methods.name: GetSockAddrFamily()
methods.description: Returns the socket address family (AF_INET, AF_INET6, or AF_BTH).

methods.name: ToSockAddr(struct sockaddr* address, socklen_t* address_length) const
FromSockAddr(const struct sockaddr* address, socklen_t address_length)
ToString()
methods.description: Returns the endpoint as a string like '127.0.0.1:80'.

methods.name: ToStringWithoutPort()
methods.description: Returns the address as a string without the port.

methods.name: ToValue()
methods.description: Serializes the endpoint to a base::Value.
